subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Reading six tourists’ views and multiple choice
outcomes: Read six tourists' views about Oman
Suggest a new title for the texts
Answer multiple-choice questions about the texts

tf.s: In 2015 the New York Times listed Oman as Number 20 of 52 top destinations.
tf.why: Yes, Oman was on the list of 52 top destinations.

tf.s: Oman is popular with tourists partly because it is a safe country.
tf.why: Right, safety is one reason visitors come.

tf.s: The texts give the views of six tourists.
tf.why: Correct, six tourists share their opinions.

tf.s: Oman has very few things to see and do.
tf.why: Oman offers a variety of things to see and do.

tf.s: 'A Warm Welcome' suggests that visitors are welcomed kindly in Oman.
tf.why: Yes, it describes Omani hospitality, not the weather.

tf.s: 'Scenery' means the people who live in a place.
tf.why: Scenery is the natural beauty of a place, like mountains.

tf.s: 'Destination' means a place people travel to.
tf.why: Yes, Oman is a popular destination.

tf.s: 'Variety' means only one kind of thing.
'Amenities' are dangers that tourists must avoid.
tf.why: Amenities are useful services, like hotels and shops.

tf.s: Friendly people are one reason tourists like Oman.
tf.why: Well done, friendly people make visitors happy.

boxes.q: Which is NOT a reason tourists enjoy Oman?
boxes.why: Oman is known for being safe.

boxes.q: Which is a good alternative title for the texts?
boxes.why: It matches the six tourists' opinions.

boxes.q: Which place did a tourist mention for its scenery?
boxes.why: Jebel Shams has amazing mountain views.

boxes.q: What shows that tourism in Oman is growing?
boxes.why: New businesses open when more tourists come.

boxes.q: What did one tourist enjoy about Oman's land?
boxes.why: Oman has mountains, deserts, beaches and more.

boxes.q: Who listed Oman as a top destination in 2015?
boxes.why: The New York Times put Oman at Number 20.

boxes.q: What do you note while reading the six views?
boxes.why: Noting key points helps you answer later.

boxes.q: What kind of tourist can enjoy Oman?

o: A person who visits a place for pleasure
boxes.why: Tourists travel to enjoy new places.
A safe country is free from danger.

hunt.q: The natural beauty of a land
More of these show tourism growth
A person who travels for pleasure

mcq.q: Why is Oman attractive to tourists?
o: Wonderful scenery, friendly people, variety and safety

mcq.q: What do the reading texts give?
mcq.why: Each text is one tourist's view.
Oman offers a variety of activities.

mcq.q: What do groups suggest after reading the texts?
mcq.why: Groups suggest and vote for the best title.

mcq.q: A tourist loves mountains and beautiful views. Which place from the texts suits them best?
mcq.why: Jebel Shams is famous for its scenery.

o: The scenery in the mountains is beautiful.
She drove the scenery to work.
The scenery called me on the phone.
mcq.why: Scenery is what you see in nature.

mcq.q: Choose the best alternative title for the six views.
mcq.why: A good title shows the main idea.

mcq.q: Why is 'A Warm Welcome' a good title for this unit?
o: It shows that visitors are treated kindly in Oman
It shows that Oman is always hot
It is about cooking warm food
It tells tourists to stay away

mcq.q: Why do more hotels and travel agencies show that tourism is growing?
o: More businesses open when more tourists come
Tourists prefer to stay at home
mcq.why: Businesses grow to serve more visitors.

mcq.q: Six different tourists all enjoyed Oman. What does this suggest?
o: Oman has something for different kinds of people
Only one place in Oman is worth visiting
The tourists did not enjoy their trips
Oman is only for young people
mcq.why: Different visitors found different things to enjoy.
